title: Identification of ageing-related genes in prostate cancer with type 2 Diabetes using machine learning: a multi-omics study focusing on SOX4, PRNP, and FOXO4.
snippet: Prostate cancer (PCa) demonstrates complex associations with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and ageing, though their interconnected molecular mechanisms remain poorly defined. title: Mechanisms of infantile hemangioma involution (Review).
snippet: Infantile hemangioma (IH) is the most common benign vascular tumor of infancy, characterized by a distinctive life cycle of rapid postnatal proliferation followed by spontaneous involution.
